title: Which Country Has the Most Time Zones?
cover_text: Who has the most time zones?

scenes.narration: Which country has the most time zones?
I'm huge, but I use only one.
With my islands, I have eleven.
Eleven too. From Europe to the Pacific.
France wins! How many time zones does your country have?

description: 🕐 France has 12 time zones, the most of any country, thanks to its overseas territories from the Pacific to the Indian Ocean. Russia and the United States (with its territories) have 11 each, and China uses just one.
comment: How many time zones does YOUR country have? 🕐👇
